name: Spadhausen
notes:
Established in 2008 and operating as an ISP since 2011, we provide Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) and Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) connectivity over our proprietary regional infrastructure, alongside nationwide coverage via wholesale agreements.

Peering Policy:
• Route Servers: Open peering policy with all IXP route servers.
• Requirements: Peers must maintain an accurate and up-to-date PeeringDB record.
• Direct Peering: We generally do not establish bilateral sessions with networks already present on the route servers. Direct peering requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
• Routing Security: AS62166 is fully compliant with MANRS (Mutually Agreed Norms for Routing Security) guidelines.
